caption: Each phase carries its effort from the fee-portal example: construction takes the biggest share at 80 of 200 person-days. The dashed arrow shows a new fee rule going back to requirements first, then through design, construction and testing again.

spec.aria: A downward flowchart from initiation through requirements, design, construction, testing, deployment and maintenance, each phase labelled with its person-days from a 200 person-day estimate, with a dashed return arrow from maintenance to requirements marked new fee rule.
